question: Which of the following organic compounds is a benzenoid?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aniline**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Aniline** is a benzenoid compound, as it contains a benzene ring in its structure.
 
• Benzenoid compounds are aromatic compounds that feature at least one benzene ring.
 
• In contrast, **acetaldehyde, propane, and hexane** are not benzenoid compounds as they do not contain a benzene ring.
